text:
An alkane molecule of molecular formula C8H18 undergoes cracking. The equation for the
reaction is shown.
C8H18→  Q  +  2R
Substance R has two carbon atoms per molecule and decolourises aqueous bromine.
What is substance Q?
A
butane
B
butene
C
ethane
D
ethene
subject: Chemistry
